text:
alex: Quick ask — need a small overnight GPU slice for a customer demo tomorrow 00:00–06:00 UTC in apac (asia-east1). Target: 4 x A100. Anyone aware of quota/standby availability?
sophia: tagging infra oncall and procurement — @devin @procurement-bot can you sanity-check capacity?
procurement-bot: nightly snapshot: asia-east1 A100 free=2, standby=1, preemptible=6. (data from 1759994300 crawl)
devin: we currently have 2 guaranteed. Can we mix 2 preemptible for burst? Demo needs low latency; prefer guaranteed where possible.
clare: proposal: 2 guaranteed + 2 preemptible, route canary traffic to guaranteed pool. If preemptibles evict, fallback to eu-west1. Preemptible saves ~60% cost.
alex: fallback to eu-west1 OK if latency stays <=200ms extra for the demo. customer agreed to tolerate small bump.
leo: I can try vendor borrow as a backup — @vendor-contact any chance to spare 2 slots in apac overnight?
vendor-contact: We can spare 2 A100s for a 6hr window tonight. Need PO/charge code + ticket number. ETA provisioning: by 23:30 UTC. Small ad-hoc fee applies. :thumbsup:
devin: great — finance ok with ad-hoc? @clare can you route billing?
clare: opened internal charge CHG-4821, finance verbally ok up to $1.2k. Please attach vendor PO once created.
alex: filing reservation now. Example command (will update with final times):
```
gcloud compute reservations create demo-res-1759 --zone=asia-east1-a --accelerator-type=nvidia-a100 --accelerator-count=4 --reservation-end=2026-03-25T06:00:00Z
```
procurement-bot: created procurement ticket PR-9321 for vendor PO and invoice flow.
devin: also opened infra change and PR to allow the reservation routing: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/891 — needs terraform approval.
alex: small ask — can someone lgtm the TF change? @sophia @leo
sophia: lgtm, only a formatting nit in variables.tf (fixed in branch).
leo: I will approve after I run a quick smoke canary against the guaranteed pool at ~23:50 UTC. If that passes I’ll merge and trigger reservation.
alex: awesome — I’ll attach vendor PO + CHG-4821 to PR once vendor confirms. will update customer after approval. :party_parrot:
vendor-bot: vendor task created: VND-10987, vendor will send PO by 22:45 UTC.
clare: note for runbook — if preemptibles evict during demo, route non-critical traffic to preemptible and pin the demo job to guaranteed instances. I’ll add to runbook.
alex: thanks all — keeping thread here for async updates. ping if anything changes.
